_about: Mark's editorial dashboard: storm-alert admin, diversion log, action queue, daily brief, newsletter, proposals. Checks: e2e/checks/editorial.mjs. Every POST in this area sends email or push or calls a paid model except declare/edit/dismiss/all-clear-skip, which run on a throwaway e2e-fixture storm on dev; the sends are tested on their refusal paths only and admitted below as gaps.

extra.email:newsletter-preview-links: Every link and picture in the weekly newsletter email (EN and ES) opens, stays in its language, and points at the public site
extra.flow:editorial-brief-buttons-match-sourc: Each button in Mark's brief action queue acts on a storm, course change, proposal or task that is still waiting for him, and everything waiting has a button
extra.flow:editorial-diversion-log-vs-storm-qu: The course-change log's live storms and open events are the storm queue's live threats and open course changes
extra.flow:editorial-storm-manual-declare: A storm declared by hand on the dashboard: declare, appear in the queue, edit, stay off the public list, refuse an early all-clear, dismiss
extra.email:storm-alert-to-subscribers: Approving a storm alert (dashboard button, brief button or email link) emails every storm-alert subscriber, one every 45 seconds
extra.email:storm-all-clear-to-subscribers: Sending the all-clear for an ended storm emails every subscriber who got the alert
extra.email:diversion-publish-to-watchers: Publishing a course change adds it to the storm's public advisories and emails the people watching that ship
extra.flow:storm-scan-on-demand: A manual storm scan reads NHC/NWS, has the model write new drafts and nudges Mark
extra.email:newsletter-weekly-send: Sending the weekly newsletter (review page, Friday auto-send, or the legacy composer) emails every confirmed subscriber of that language
extra.flow:newsletter-generate-edit-notify: Generating an issue (paid model), saving Mark's edits to it, and the review nudge to his phone
extra.push:daily-brief-delivery: The daily brief run assembles the brief and pushes it to Mark's phone
extra.flow:brief-buttons-act-on-real-items: Resolving an action, approving/dismissing a proposal (including an SEO change applied on approval), closing/keeping a task changes that real item and clears it from the brief
extra.flow:brief-ops-feed-section-errors: When the ops-manager cannot read the calendar, Gmail, tasks, notes, bills or pulse, the daily brief says so instead of showing an empty section

email:storm-alert-to-subscribers.reason: Approving emails real subscribers on either box (dev sends real email) and there is no fixture subscriber list or mail sink; only the refusal paths (no key, wrong key) are tested. Needs a dev-only mail sink or a subscriber filter for e2e-fixture alerts.

email:storm-all-clear-to-subscribers.reason: Same as the alert send: an all-clear on an ended storm emails real subscribers. Tested: no key, wrong key, unknown storm (404) and a not-yet-ended storm (409) on the fixture.

email:diversion-publish-to-watchers.reason: Publishing writes to a real storm's public advisories and emails ship watchers; the dev simulate endpoint creates a brief action and runs the intel lookup. Tested: refusals and an unknown event (404). Needs a fixture course change on a fixture storm with no watchers.

flow:storm-scan-on-demand.reason: A scan calls the model to write drafts and nudges Mark (the test mode injects a fixture system that does the same). Tested: refusals only.

email:newsletter-weekly-send.reason: Sending emails every confirmed subscriber (dev sends real email). Tested: refusals, and the legacy composer's empty-subject / empty-story-list rejections (both refused before any store is read; the unknown-story path is deliberately not sent, since a story-matching bug there would email every dev subscriber).

flow:newsletter-generate-edit-notify.reason: Generating is a paid model call plus a push; notify is a push; saving an edit rewrites the only real draft. Tested: refusals and the empty-issue rejection (nothing saved). Needs a fixture draft store or a dry-run flag.

push:daily-brief-delivery.reason: The run pushes to Mark's phone. The assembly half is tested on dev through GET /api/brief?fresh=1; the push is not.

flow:brief-buttons-act-on-real-items.reason: There is no way to create a fixture action, proposal or task through the site without a notification (createAction notifies; tasks are written by the ops-manager). Tested: refusals and no-op answers for unknown ids.

flow:brief-ops-feed-section-errors.reason: The ops-manager's /brief/feed returns per-section errors, but lib/brief.ts drops them: a failed calendar or Gmail read reaches Mark's brief as an empty section with opsReachable=true (dev's calendar read has failed with Google 404 this way). The site exposes nothing a check can read; the feed itself needs IDEAS_API_KEY, which the harness does not hold. Needs the brief to carry the feed's errors (e.g. brief.opsErrors), then the brief check asserts it empty.
